scoring_justification: Quantities are fixed paper-reported values; a closeness check against the paper’s gold with generous tolerances is appropriate. An additional intermediate value (predicted conversion at 600s) ensures that the ODE model was actually executed.

hidden_assets.purpose: paper-reported headline quantities and an ODE-derived intermediate
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper abstract and Results: k2~2e6 s⁻¹, k8~5e2 s⁻¹, E2=25.0 kcal/mol, E8=35.6 kcal/mol, ΔHf(EtSiH)=47.7 kcal/mol, group additivity -1.3 kcal/mol. The predicted conversion at 600 s (44.3%) is taken from the model calculation in Table 1 (723 K, 600 s, calc(*)).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual paper-reported numbers, traceable to the abstract, text, and appendix.

outputs.description: Final derived quantities: fitted rate constants at 723 K (k2_at_723K, k8_at_723K), high-pressure activation energies (E2_inf, E8_inf) in kcal/mol, heat of formation of ethylsilylene (delta_Hf_EtSiH) in kcal/mol, group additivity value (group_additivity_C_H2_C_Si) in kcal/mol, and the model-predicted ES conversion percentage at 600 s (predicted_ES_conversion_pct_600s) as a direct check of ODE integration.

output_contract.notes: Only the load-bearing output file is listed in the output contract. Process steps produce intermediate files not evaluated by the verifier.
